name: Reuben
source: The protagonist of Artificial Mansion. Reuben inherits his uncle's mansion after his death. He likes reading and recreational writing. Little does he know, there is more to this mansion when he finds life-sized dolls. With Lottie and Briar's help, he has to survive against Adelaide, a doll that won't stop until he is dead.
